approved: Aboriginal Land Grant (Jervis Bay Territory) Amendment (Strengthening Land and Governance Provisions) Bill 2022
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would amend the Aboriginal Land Grant (Jervis Bay Territory) Act to strengthen land and governance provisions, responding to a committee recommendation.
It would require the Chief Executive Officer and the executive committee to consider criteria such as training or experience before delegating decision-making powers.
The bill would also set new rules for the form of leases granted by the Council and change how certain leases apply to the ACT's residential tenancies law.
Adds criteria the Chief Executive Officer must consider before delegating powers.
Adds criteria the executive committee must consider before delegating powers.
Inserts requirements for the form of a lease granted by the Council.
Removes the words 'before, at or' from the application provision for a new lease section.
The Wreck Bay Aboriginal Community Council and its members, who hold or manage land in Jervis Bay Territory.
